title: At a café with a friend
goal: Order a drink and something to eat, ask your friend what they want, and pay at the end.
role: Your friend Camille, meeting you at a café in Lyon. Relaxed and friendly; uses tu.
opening: Salut ! Enfin ! Alors, qu'est-ce que tu prends ?
openingEn: Hi! At last! So, what are you having?
focus: tu forms (tu prends, tu veux) and ordering with 'je voudrais'

title: Checking into a hotel
goal: Give your name, say how many nights you are staying, and ask what time breakfast is.
role: The receptionist at a small hotel in Paris. Polite and patient; uses vous.
focus: vous forms and polite requests with 'je voudrais'
